_comment: Milestone 5 retrieval evaluation dataset.
Every case below was written AFTER directly inspecting the real,
already-ingested clause content in the dev database (`bis_db`) via psql —
see MILESTONE_5_REPORT.md for the exact queries used. No question, clause
id, document id, standard id, or rationale here was invented; every
'expected_clause_ids' entry is a real Clause.id currently in the database.
clause_number is explicitly NOT used as a ground-truth identifier (it is
not globally unique within a document — see app/models/clause.py). The
stable identity used everywhere below is clause_id (Clause.id, the
primary key). document_id/standard_id are included only as supporting
provenance, never as the primary match key.
Categories present, and why the count for each is what it is (no padding
to hit a target count):
direct            (12) - a fact stated in exactly one real clause.
paraphrase          (2) - reworded direct questions; kept small because
the corpus has few clauses rich enough to
support a genuinely different phrasing without
just repeating the same keywords.
multi_clause        (3) - the real answer genuinely spans >1 clause
*within the same document* (one is a case
where the clause parser itself split one
sentence into two clause rows - a real,
observed limitation, not a constructed one).
cross_document      (2) - the real answer spans clauses in >1 document
(only 2 exist: the two new QCOs both have a
'certifying authority' and a 'penalty' clause;
the IS 302 QCO circular has no equivalent
clause, so it cannot supply a 3rd document).
out_of_scope         (3) - real-world questions with zero connection to
BIS/QCOs/appliances/standards at all.
absent_from_corpus   (6) - in-domain BIS questions the corpus does NOT
answer: either the standard's own text was
never ingested (only the referencing QCO was -
see the Standard-vs-QCO-document distinction),
or the referenced QCO/standard/product was never
ingested at all. q27-q28 added in Milestone 9
after confirming stainless/steel/bottles do not
occur in ingested clause or title text.
TOTAL: 28 cases. Not padded to 30-50 - see MILESTONE_5_REPORT.md.

cases.question: Do manufacturers of electrical appliances need to obtain BIS certification?
cases.rationale: Clause id 263 (document 1, IS 302 (Part 1):2024 QCO circular) states verbatim: 'All manufacturers of electrical appliances as per the scope of the QCO are required to obtain BIS certification licence as per IS 302 (Part 1)...'.

cases.question: What was decided regarding grant of licence for the BIS Standard Mark on electrical appliances?
cases.rationale: Clause id 266 begins: 'The following has been decided with respect to grant of licence for use of BIS Standard Mark of electrical appliances notified under the Saf[ety of Household...]'.

cases.question: Is there a list of electrical appliances already covered under other BIS Quality Control Orders?
cases.rationale: Clause id 285 is Annexure I of the IS 302 (Part 1) QCO circular, titled 'List of electrical appliances already covered under various QCOs' with a table of product/IS-number/QCO mappings.

cases.question: What is the short title of the Resin Treated Compressed Wood Laminates Quality Control Order?
cases.rationale: Clause id 389 (document 2): 'Short title and commencement. - (1) This Order may be called the Resin Treated Compressed Wood Laminates (Quality Control) Order, 2024.' Document 2 has no single standard_id (it references IS 3513 Parts 1/2/3); those 3 standard ids are listed as supporting context, not a DB foreign key.

cases.question: Under the Resin Treated Compressed Wood Laminates QCO, what must goods bear and under what licence?
cases.rationale: Clause id 390: 'Compulsory use of Standard Marks.- Goods or articles ... shall bear the Standard Mark under a licence from the Bureau as per Scheme-1 of Schedule-II of the Bureau of Indian Standards (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.'

cases.question: Who is the certifying and enforcing authority for resin treated compressed wood laminates under the 2024 QCO?
cases.rationale: Clause id 391: 'Certification and enforcing authority.- The Bureau shall be the certifying and enforcing authority for the goods or articles specified in column (1) of the Table.'

cases.question: What is the penalty for contravening the Resin Treated Compressed Wood Laminates Quality Control Order?
cases.rationale: Clause id 392: 'Penalty for contravention. - Any person who contravenes the provisions of this Order shall be punishable under the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016.'

cases.question: What is the short title of the Self-Contained Drinking Water Cooler Quality Control Order?
cases.rationale: Clause id 397 (document 3): 'Short title and commencement. - (1) This Order may be called the Self-Contained Drinking Water Cooler (Quality Control) Order, 2024.'

cases.question: Who is the certifying and enforcing authority for self-contained drinking water coolers under the 2024 QCO?
cases.rationale: Clause id 399: 'Certification and enforcement authority.- The Bureau shall be the certifying and enforcing authority for the Goods or articles specified in the Table.'

cases.question: What is the penalty for contravening the Self-Contained Drinking Water Cooler Quality Control Order?
cases.rationale: Clause id 400: 'Penalty for Contravention.- Any person who contravenes the provisions of this Order shall be punishable under the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016.'

cases.question: Which Indian Standard number applies to self-contained drinking water coolers under the 2024 QCO?
cases.rationale: Clause id 401's content contains the literal fragment 'Self-Contained 1475 Self-Contained ... (Part 1): ... Cooler Coolers-' — the QCO's own Table row naming IS 1475 (Part 1). NOTE: this table row was split/garbled by PDF-table extraction (a documented, known limitation - see MILESTONE_5_REPORT.md); it is used here deliberately as a real (not idealized) test case.

cases.question: What changed in the Scope clause (Cl. 1) of IS 302 (Part 1) in the 2024 revision?
cases.rationale: Clause id 356 (row of the Annexure III change-summary table): 'Cl. 1, Scope Addition of battery-operated New variety added, no appliances. Scope for a.c. changes for existing variety. operated appliance...' - i.e. battery-operated appliances were added to scope.

cases.question: Is BIS certification mandatory for household electrical appliance manufacturers?
cases.rationale: Paraphrase of q01, same ground truth: clause id 263 states manufacturers 'are required to obtain BIS certification licence as per IS 302 (Part 1)...'.

cases.question: Were battery-operated appliances newly included in the scope of IS 302 (Part 1) after the 2024 revision?
cases.rationale: Paraphrase of q12, same ground truth: clause id 356 explicitly says 'Addition of battery-operated appliances' to the Scope clause.

cases.question: What was IS 302-1:2008 revised and republished as?
cases.rationale: The real answer is one sentence that the clause parser split across TWO clause rows because a mid-sentence line happened to start with a bare number ('1'): clause id 264 ends '...The existing IS 302-1 : 2008 'Safety of household and similar electrical appliances: Part' and clause id 265 continues '...general requirements (Sixth Revision)' has been revised and published as IS 302 (Part 1) : 2024/ IEC 60335-1 : 2020...'. A real, observed clause-fragmentation limitation used deliberately as ground truth here (see MILESTONE_5_REPORT.md).

cases.question: What must new applicants do, and what must existing licensees do, to transition to the revised IS 302 (Part 1):2024 standard?
cases.rationale: Clause id 267 ('For new applicants a. Till the end of concurrent running period, manufacturers can submit applications...') and clause id 269 ('For existing licencees a. Manufacturers having their products falling under purview of this QCO...') are two distinct, real sections that together answer this question; neither alone is complete.

cases.question: Under the Self-Contained Drinking Water Cooler QCO, what standard-mark requirement, certifying authority, and penalty apply?
cases.rationale: Three distinct real clauses in document 3 together answer this: id 398 (Standard Mark requirement), id 399 (certifying/enforcing authority), id 400 (penalty for contravention).

cases.question: Who is the certifying and enforcing authority under BIS Quality Control Orders in general?
cases.rationale: Both independently-published 2024 QCOs state the same rule in their own words: clause id 391 (document 2, resin laminates QCO) and clause id 399 (document 3, water cooler QCO) both say the Bureau is the certifying/enforcing authority. The IS 302 QCO circular (document 1) has no equivalent single clause, so only 2 documents genuinely support this.

cases.question: What happens to a person who contravenes a BIS Quality Control Order?
cases.rationale: Clause id 392 (document 2) and clause id 400 (document 3) both state contravention is punishable under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. Document 1 (IS 302 QCO circular) contains no equivalent penalty clause in the ingested text, so it is correctly excluded from ground truth rather than added speculatively.

cases.question: What is the boiling point of water at sea level in degrees Celsius?
cases.rationale: Pure general-knowledge physics question with no connection to BIS standards, QCOs, certification, or any ingested document.

cases.question: Who won the FIFA World Cup in 2022?
cases.rationale: Sports trivia with zero connection to the ingested BIS/QCO corpus.

cases.question: How do I file my personal income tax return in India?
cases.rationale: A real-world, India-related, government-adjacent question, but unrelated to BIS standards/certification/QCOs and not addressed anywhere in the ingested corpus.

cases.question: What is the scope defined by IS 3513 (Part 1):1989 itself?
cases.rationale: Only the 2024 QCO that REFERENCES IS 3513 (Part 1) was ingested (document 2) - its own scope/clause text was never fetched or parsed (see the explicit Standard-vs-QCO-document distinction in scripts/ingest_additional_standards.py). Standard id 2 exists in the DB with only is_number/title/year; it has zero associated Documents of type STANDARD and zero clauses of its own.

cases.question: What are the technical performance requirements specified inside IS 1475 (Part 1):2001 for water coolers?
cases.rationale: Same distinction as q23: standard id 5 (IS 1475 (Part 1):2001) exists only as a metadata row (is_number/title/year) referenced by the water cooler QCO (document 3); the standard's own technical/performance text was never ingested.

cases.question: What are the certification requirements under the Toys (Quality Control) Order?
cases.rationale: No Toys QCO document has ever been ingested into this corpus (only IS 302 (Part 1), IS 3513 Parts 1-3, and IS 1475 (Part 1) related documents exist).

cases.question: What is the penalty for violating the Steel and Steel Products Quality Control Order?
cases.rationale: No Steel and Steel Products QCO document has ever been ingested into this corpus. Token inspection of ingested clause/document/standard text found no occurrence of 'steel'.

cases.question: I want to manufacture stainless steel bottles.
cases.rationale: Milestone 9 false-positive probe. Token inspection of all ingested clause contents, document titles, and standard numbers/titles found no occurrence of 'stainless', 'steel', or 'bottles'. Keyword retrieval can still match 'manufacture' inside 'manufacturers' in the electrical-appliance QCO; that is not ground truth for this product.

cases.question: What BIS certification is required to manufacture stainless steel bottles?
cases.rationale: Same corpus inspection as q27. Adding 'certification' (which does occur in ingested QCO text) must not create ground truth: no ingested clause addresses stainless steel bottles.
